nom: Filorga Hydra-Hyal Cream-Gel, Anti-Aging Facial Treatment for Hydrated and Plumped Skin, Pore Refining Formula with Hyaluronic Acid for Mattifying Hydration for All Skin Types

avis.texte: For the expense- very disappointed. After applying it became dry. Trying to gently massage it, it turned to become a few particles like mini-clumps. Very poor quality. I was so excited when I got this— VERY DISAPPOINTED
Horrible producto me dejo la cara roja. Estoy arrepentida de gastar $50.

avis.titre: It’s a great moisturizer for mature skin
avis.texte: I love this product. However, I will no longer order thru Amazon. The last shipment was tampered with. Outside shrinkwrap/plastic was missing, inside foil to protect product was gone and the jar was empty. Appeared I received a used product.
I have very sensitive skin but have had no problem using this at all, and I have used others in the range too.
Expensive, but did not see wow results. Much cheaper creams did better job.

El efecto de hidratación se percibe desde el primer uso y para nada deja sensación grasosa o brillo visible. Mi dermatóloga me la recomendó ya que al padecer rosácea la sensibilidad de mi piel es alta. Para mí superó las expectativas
